confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of UK and Scottish Highland pricing; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, since July is peak tourist season in Inverness and nightly rates vary widely by date, location, and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general UK pricing for small-to-mid-sized Scottish tourist towns and cities (for example Stirling and Perth), with a July peak-season uplift for accommodation given Inverness's role as a gateway to the Highlands and Loch Ness.
